summary: Periodic maintenance verification: no pending package updates; integration acceptance needs attention
changes: No package, installed code, configuration, service, desktop, driver or job changes. Refreshed the prepared separate update-check database and created private diagnostic, review, rollback and proposal records. A sanitized receipt is prepared for the authorized personal maintenance history.
tests: Current ChatGPT OAuth login confirmed. Repository check returned no pending updates. Package database consistency and essential file checks passed before and after; ChatGPT detailed package integrity reported no altered files. Full installed inventory and protected configuration hashes remained identical. Existing root permissions, trusted package-signature requirement, optimized repositories and maintenance timer were preserved. The previous integration conclusion was verified against its recorded digest; integration tests were not rerun. No graphical, gaming or performance tests were executed.
rollback: No installed system changes were made, so no system rollback is necessary. The separate repository-check cache is regenerable; private evidence is retained. No restoration of previous sessions or unrelated files was attempted.
problem: The compatibility update service remains failed because previous fresh-proof acceptance was incomplete: prompt binding and invocation validation failed, and required native lineage and artifact-readback capabilities were unavailable in the headless run. The installed desktop also differs from the recorded KDE preference.
solution: Preserved the failed status, previous compatibility baseline, dispatch ledger and existing desktop session. Recorded a local proposal to inspect proof-generation defects and renew acceptance in a session exposing the required native capabilities; desktop reconciliation is a separate local proposal. No gate was weakened and no uncertain executor was replayed.
reproduction: Observed the existing failed service, checked the private conclusion digest and compared current package, configuration and automation state. This is a custom-integration acceptance issue; no reproducible CachyOS distribution defect or tested upstream fix was established.
